Nineteenth TU reconstruction pilot: ov002/daSoundObj_c. Single-class TU, key-function TU for _ZTV12daSoundObj_c. include/daSoundObj_c.h was already correct real inheritance going in (struct daSoundObj_c : dActor_c), with a header comment noting only the destructor slots (16/17) differ from the base's own vtable -- Behavior/InitResources are plain (non-virtual) member functions here, not overrides, matching the ROM's own vtable layout exactly as documented. Two generator conflicts on _ZN5Sound7PlaySubEjjj5Fix12IiEb's extern declaration (bool vs int, Fix12i vs Fix12 -- both plain int under the hood) were confirmed byte-neutral and cleaned up, along with a stray unterminated declaration fragment the generator left outside its CONFLICT comment (a genuine syntax error, not a reconciliation judgement call). D0/D1 followed the classic mwcc ICE shape (tenth-plus confirmed occurrence): a hand-written mangled _ZN12daSoundObj_cD0Ev next to a real out-of-line D1 ICEs mwccarm 2004/b56 (ELFgen.c:483); deleted the hand-written body and let the compiler synthesize D0 from D1. daSoundObj_c_Spawn needed the standard +2 vtable addend fix. InitResources initially DIFFERed (999 words, wrong reloc destination) even though it verified fine standalone -- root cause was #pragma opt_loop_invariants off from the legacy file, which the generator correctly declined to carry automatically. This pragma is FILE-GLOBAL last-wins like opt_propagation/optimize_for_size, NOT positional like long_calls: an off/on bracket around just this member had NO effect (the trailing `on` at the end of the file made the whole TU's effective state `on` again). Fixed by adding a single unbracketed `#pragma opt_loop_invariants off` before this member and leaving it off for the rest of the file -- safe here because no other member in this TU contains a loop. 7/7 MATCH, objisolate clean, reloc-destinations clean -> TEXT-VERIFIED. linkcheck --partial: 7/7 contribution-equivalent, module still 106/106 exact, 0 new dsd check symbols errors vs baseline -> PARTIAL-LINK-VERIFIED, correctly predicted clean in advance by the D0/Spawn grep (both reference _ZTV12daSoundObj_c directly, no coined-alias mismatch).

The coined class name SoundObject was renamed to the cartridge's own daSoundObj_c in the preceding commit, which is the enabling step rather than a tidy-up: ov002 0x0210c048 is a __si_class_type_info whose _ZTS at 0x0210c054 reads exactly `12daSoundObj_c` and whose one base at subobject offset 0 is arm9 0x0208e390, _ZTI8dActor_c. Under the coined name none of the nine vague-linkage records this TU emits had a ROM home to be compared against; all nine do now, and coo lookup found every one in config/**/symbols.txt. THE DESTRUCTOR MOVED INLINE into include/daSoundObj_c.h and that is the promotion's load-bearing edit -- out of line, mwccarm 2004/b56 emitted D0 before D1 (the reverse of the cartridge, D1 0x020f934c, D0 0x020f9370) and added a homeless D2 that objisolate refused as unlicensed .text, which took the whole TU down rather than one function. Inline, the pair comes out in ROM order with no D2, and tubuild verify's functions_occur_in_expected_order went from PARTIAL (pair (0,1)) to PASS on all 7. That lever is only safe on a leaf, and the leaf is measured, not assumed: the word 0x0210c048 occurs exactly once anywhere under extracted/ -- ov002 offset 0x5ea78, i.e. 0x0210c0d8, the typeinfo slot of its own vtable header at _ZTV-4 (the two scan hits are the same image under extracted/dsd/arm9_overlays/ov002.bin and extracted/overlays/overlay_0002.bin). Per-symbol romdata verdicts, via rombuild.compile_one's data sink: _ZTV12daSoundObj_c VERIFIED across the 124 bytes dsd's extent covers = 31 slots; _ZTI12daSoundObj_c, _ZTI8dActor_c, _ZTI7dBase_c, _ZTI7fBase_c VERIFIED; the four _ZTS records PARTIAL (the known dsd extent shortfall, not a byte disagreement); nothing DIFFERS. The vtable claim is scoped to the SLOTS deliberately -- the symbols.txt _ZTV address is the address point, 8 bytes past the table's real start, and the {offset-to-top, _ZTI pointer} header pair is emitted here and word-compared by nothing. The one pragma keeps its pilot-era resolution: opt_loop_invariants is the file-global last-wins kind, so it stays unbracketed at InitResources (no long_calls appears in this TU). rombuild.py -j16: 106/106 exact, 100.000000%, mismatching 0.
